title: Past Simple, time expressions and everyday stories

sections.title: Lesson notes
sections.content: A review of completed past events, common time expressions and clear sentence order.

questions.prompt: Choose a past-time expression.
Choose the correct past sentence.
choices: I was visit my aunt yesterday.

questions.prompt: Which word can begin a past story?
Choose the natural word order.
choices: Yesterday I to the market went.
Went I to the market yesterday.
I went to the market yesterday.

sections.title: Grammar practice
sections.content: Use the Past Simple for a finished action. After did, use the base verb.

questions.prompt: Fill in the blank: We ___ dinner at seven.
Choose the correct question.
Fill in the blank: They ___ home late.
Which sentence uses at correctly?
choices: I called her at the morning.
I called her at six o’clock.

sections.title: Vocabulary
sections.content: Practise useful words for everyday past stories.

questions.prompt: A plan is an arrangement you make before something happens.
Choose the word for a place where you wait for a bus.
Fill in the blank: I sent a short ___ to my friend.
Which word means “later than expected”?

sections.title: Reading
sections.content: Read three short stories for the main event, place and time.

sections.title: Listening
sections.content: Listen for a short everyday story and note the sequence of events.

sections.title: Final review
sections.content: Mix grammar and vocabulary in one final review.

questions.prompt: Choose a correct Past Simple verb.
